theme: Light, Pine palette. Every color is a theme token; dark mode and the Espresso, Clay and Plum palettes exist in the design and swap the same tokens.
globalNotes: All amounts pass through one visibility policy with four levels: Show, Soft (word or fill bar), Later (locked until reveal time), Hide (nothing renders, label included). Blind screens are the same layouts with amounts removed, not greyed out.
Meal colors only tell things apart (breakfast = carbs/orange, lunch = fat/blue, snack = fiber/brown, dinner = protein/pink). No color means over, under, good or bad. The app uses no red anywhere.
Bars stop at 100%. Going over a target never shows an overflow color or a warning.
Bottom nav is one shared component: Today, Trends, center + (opens the logger), Foods, More. The coach role uses a 4-tab bar with no +.
Touch targets are at least 48 dp. Type is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, rem-based, scaling with the system font size.
Visibility choices (number, trend, hidden, vitamins on) live only in Modes and numbers, behind the optional pause. Content screens never get a one-tap toggle that shows more numbers.
